title: The Man in the Pantry Door
summary: A head-and-shoulders silhouette stands in a closed frosted pantry door each evening. An empty coat hanger inside suggests a hanging coat. But the pantry is empty when opened. A small counter lamp projects the combined shadow of a round perforated colander and a navy tea towel on the dish rack onto the outside of the glass. Moving the colander breaks the head away from the shoulders.
